description: Deterministic bounded multilayer annealed particle filtering with supplied resampling and normal-shock tapes.

source.title: PARSEC Bodytrack annealed particle filter
authors: Jörg Deutscher, Andrew Blake, Ian Reid
source.algorithm_attribution: Multi-layer continuation of the observation likelihood, weighted resampling between layers, and a weighted pose estimate.
source.reuse: Algorithm attribution only; this bounded rational-likelihood profile and all implementations are clean-room.

input.field_order: Within each layer, initial poses and shocks are particle-major, then coordinate-major. Uniform draws are layer-major, then child-particle-major.
input.beta_rule: beta values strictly increase across layers.
input.sigma_rule: Transition spreads are non-increasing. Each spread and pose is in milli-pose units.
input.uniform_range: 0 <= u < 2^24; u / 2^24 is the discrete uniform variate.
input.shock_units: signed thousandths of a standard normal variate

contract.layer_weight_q24: Initialize weight=base_likelihood_q24, then perform beta-1 multiplications by base_likelihood_q24, flooring each product divided by 2^24.
contract.resampling: For each child, threshold=floor(u*sum(weights)/2^24); choose the first ancestor whose cumulative weight is greater than threshold.
contract.transition: Copy the selected ancestor, then add round-half-away-from-zero(sigma*shock/1000) to each coordinate and clamp to [-10000,10000].
contract.final_estimate: At the last layer, return each coordinate's weighted mean rounded half away from zero.

workspace.meaning: Two bounded 16-by-4 i64 particle buffers, 16 i64 likelihood weights, and scalar bookkeeping.
